svg.title: kocayinsec. Builds web and mobile products, studies how they break.
svg.desc: A line drawing of an owl on a branch, in ivory and copper, in front of a faint moon ring, beside the name kocayinsec. The owl is drawn stroke by stroke, opens its eyes, breathes, and now and then leans over to look at the name, whose i-dot warms to copper while it looks.
